jp.title: 関東～九州は秋晴れ多い 真夏日予想も 平地の紅葉シーズンはしばらく先 1か月予報
jp.description: 気象庁は今日8日、最新の1か月予報を発表しました。東日本と西日本、沖縄・奄美では向こう1か月の日照時間は平年並みか多く、来週後半にかけて秋晴れが続く見込みです。全国的に高温傾向で、最高気温30℃以上の真夏日となる所もありそうです。季節の進みはゆっくりで、平地の紅葉シーズンはまだしばらく先となりそうです。

world.title: High-resolution global atmospheric model erases 'popcornlike' rain
world.description: Global climate and weather forecasting use predictive models that divide Earth's atmosphere into a grid, with each section typically covering tens to hundreds of kilometers. Now a new model, run by a team at the University of Tokyo, has narrowed this grid spacing to just 220 meters (720 feet). This higher resolution eliminated instances of "popcornlike" rain—bursts of heavy rain that appear in simulations but not in real life—providing more accurate predictions of extreme local weather from a global model.
